function.name: _app_define_object_log_count
function.description:
Query the total number of designer model change logs for the current application.

Use cases:
- Check how many design change records exist for the current application
- Count design change records by operation type
- Get a total before paginating through change records

Notes:
- Reads only the current application
- Does not modify data
- Currently supports only the opt filter
- Supported opt values include: Create, Update, Delete, GitSync, Install, Upgrade, Publish

opt.description: Operation type filter. Supported values: Create, Update, Delete, GitSync, Install, Upgrade, Publish. Omit this field to count all design change records for the current application.
